review_comments.body:
the fallback key can collide across chunks: [a, b] with no index get keys 0 and 2, then a later chunk with c lands on 2 again so b is dropped and c ends up with `{}{}` as args. taking the next free key fixes it

```suggestion
                        index = max(tool_accs, default=-1) + 1
```

pushed the fix plus a test here, should cherry pick clean on your branch: https://github.com/its-amann/ag2/commit/0ec287ceb7fc5a4ea76237744a3fc75c2203d166
thanks! mind adding `Co-authored-by: Aman Agnihotri <amanagnihotri902@gmail.com>` to 3a8000d when it gets squashed? the fix came from my suggestion
Sure, the next-free-key approach in 3a8000d is yours, so please add `Co-authored-by: Aman Agnihotri <amanagnihotri902@gmail.com>` to the squash commit message. Thanks for catching the collision.

comments.body:
Good catch, thanks @its-amann: the position-based fallback key could collide across chunks and drop a call. Applied your suggested `max(tool_accs, default=-1) + 1` and added a regression test (`[a, b]` then `[c]`, all without index).

This comment was drafted with Claude Code.
